title: Networking & IT infrastructure
summary: Structured cabling, racks, Wi-Fi and clean power, built into the fit-out and handed over tested and documented.
intro: Every system in a modern office runs on the network. We plan and install the cabling, racks, switching, Wi-Fi and power your IT team needs, route it through floors, ceilings and furniture as the interior is built, and hand it over tested, labelled and documented.

points.title: Planned at layout stage
points.text: Data points, cable routes, rack rooms and power are fixed with the furniture layout, so nothing is chased into finished walls later.

points.title: Tested and documented
points.text: Every cable labelled and tested, with drawings and test reports at handover.

points.title: Coverage everywhere
points.text: Wi-Fi access points placed from a survey of the floor, for reliable coverage in meeting rooms and open areas.

points.title: Power that stays on
points.text: UPS and clean power for server rooms, network racks and critical workstations.

includes: Structured cabling: Cat6 and Cat6A copper
Fibre backbone between floors and racks
Network racks, patch panels and cable management
Network switches and Wi-Fi access points
Firewalls and routers, set up with your IT team
UPS, power distribution and earthing for IT

faqs.question: Will you work with our IT team?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work to your IT team’s standards for cabling, equipment and security, and coordinate configuration and switchover with them.

faqs.question: Do you provide UPS and backup power for IT?
faqs.answer: Yes. We size and install UPS systems for server rooms, network racks and critical workstations, with the power distribution and earthing they need.

metaDescription: Office networking and IT infrastructure in Mumbai: structured cabling, fibre, racks, Wi-Fi, server rooms and UPS, installed with your fit-out.
